(Person/Group shall be allowed to speak without interruption up to five (5) minutes maximum time, subject to compliance with applicable meeting rules. Questions to the speaker or responses to the speaker's
questions or comments shall be handled after the speaker has completed his/her comments. Public Participation will be limited to sixty (60) minutes time.)

None

CONSENT CALENDAR
The Consent Calendar adopting the printed recommended actions will be enacted with one vote. If Councilmembers or Staff wish to address any item on the Consent Calendar
individually, it will be considered under SPECIAL CALL ITEMS.
1.
Minutes of the Utility Board Meeting on July 26, 2021 Recommendation: 1) Approve Minutes as written.
E-1.1. Utility Board Minutes 7-26-21
2.
Approve the Specifications and Authorize the Solicitation of Bids for Project LD2021-03 - Furnishing and Installing of Underground Substructures at 1151 West Arrow Highway Recommendation: 1) Approve plan and specifications for project LD2021-03; and 2) Authorize the advertisement and solicitation of bids for Project LD2021-03 - Furnishing and Installing of Underground Electric Substructures.
E-2.1. Approve Bid and Specifications for Project LD2021-3
E-2.2. Drawing ED2021-03 - Furnishing and Installing Underground Substructures at 1151 W. Arrow Hwy.
E-2.3. Bid Specifications LD2021-3
3.
Award Kirkwall Substation Electric Relay Replacement Contract to Siemens Industry Incorporated in the Amount of $164,215.17 Recommendation: 1) Approve the Award of Relays Replacement Contract to Siemens Industry Inc. in the amount not-to-exceed $164,215.17; and 2) Authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement for Maintenance Services in a form acceptable to the City Attorney.
E-3.1. Award Relays Replacement at Kirkwall Substation
E-3.2. Siemens Bid Proposal
E-3.3. SEL Bid Proposal
E-3.4. Relay Replacement Contract Agreement
4.
Approve the Purchase of Oracle Database Enterprise Edition Licensing Through Sytems & Software, Inc. Recommendation: 1) Approve a sole source purchase order with Systems & Software, Inc., as provided under Municipal Code Sec. 2-520(b)(2), in an amount not-to-exceed i) $96,532 for the purchase of Oracle Database Enterprise Edition and ii) $17,407 per year in increased maintenance costs to support the database server.
E-4.1. Approval of the Purchase of Oracle Database Enterprise Edition
E-4.2. Oracle Terms & Conditions Plus Quote
5.
Approve the Purchase of Meter Data Management System Module Updates From Smartworks Harris Computer Corporation Recommendation: 1) Approve a sole source purchase order with Harris Computer, Corporation, as provided under Municipal Code Sec. 2-520(b)(2), in an amount not-to-exceed i) $113,790 for the purchase of updated MDMS modules and ii) $14,460 per year in increased maintenance costs for ongoing software support for these additional modules.
E-5.1. Approval of the Purchase of Updated MDMS Modules from SmartWorks Harris
E-5.2. Services Statement of Work for the Move In and Move Out & Automated Service Connect and Reconnect Module
E-5.3. Services Statement of Work for the Leak Detection Module
E-5.4. Services Statement of Work for the Water Loss Module
F.
STAFF REPORTS/COMMUNICATIONS
1.

F-1.2. 4th Quarter Water Utility Operating Budget Report FY 20-21
